FOR jk-01 (empire-of-japan) and ea (united-states-army-military-government-in-korea): Korea south of 38N is a loss in empire-of-japan /ledger/77 but an occupation here (1945-09..1948-08); the US now mirrors Japan's Guam, Wake, Attu, Kiska, Philippines, Okinawa and Amami occupations; not mirrored: the 1945 Mandate islands loss (/ledger/79) and the Bonin and Volcano Islands (/ledger/82).
